title: The Airlock

section1.heading: The problem nobody talks about
section1.body1: The most dangerous thing about AI is not that it gets things wrong. It's that it acts before you can check. A sales bot offers a 40% discount that violates margin policy. A booking system double-schedules because it optimized for density without understanding drive time. These aren't hypotheticals.
section1.body2: Only 6% of enterprises say they fully trust autonomous AI agents. The other 94% are right to be cautious. We built the opposite: every action the AI takes passes through what we call the Airlock — a mandatory preview where you see exactly what's about to happen before it happens.

comparison.auto: Sent immediately. CEO finds a typo after 200 people read it.
comparison.airlock: Draft appears as a card. You fix the typo, tap send.

comparison.auto: Double-booked Tuesday — didn't check your personal calendar.
comparison.airlock: Preview shows the conflict. You pick the right slot.

comparison.auto: 14 tasks from one meeting. 6 are duplicates.
comparison.airlock: Proposed list. You merge two, delete one, approve the rest.

comparison.auto: Replied with a coupon you don't offer anymore.
comparison.airlock: Reply appears as preview. You adjust the offer, then send.

section3.heading: Not a UI pattern. A security protocol.
section3.body: Every write action generates an HMAC-SHA256 signed confirmation token binding the user, the exact action, and the precise arguments — down to individual characters in an email draft. Tokens expire in 10 minutes. If anything changes between preview and confirmation, the token invalidates. The AI cannot modify the action after showing it to you. What you approved is exactly what gets executed.

quote: "The pause is not a limitation. It's the reason you'll trust this with your business."

section4.heading: Your data. Your infrastructure. Your rules.
section4.body: Trust isn't just about what the AI does — it's about where your data lives. HABOS runs wherever you need it: our cloud, your servers, or fully air-gapped with zero internet dependency. The same platform, the same features, wherever your data needs to be.

deploymentOptions.title: On-Prem
deploymentOptions.body: Deploy the full backend at your location. Run Qwen models on standard Mac hardware for local AI — no GPU cluster required.

deploymentOptions.title: Air-Gapped Datacenter
